metadata.title: Services
metadata.description: Explore verified service categories on Bharosa Hai.

hero.title: Find the right help for everyday important work.
hero.copy: Choose a service category and understand what kind of verified provider can help you.

overview.title: What service do you need?
overview.copy: Browse the main Bharosa Hai service categories. Use the Services menu to jump directly to any section.

legal-services.overview: Help from legal professionals for notices, agreements, affidavits and local legal paperwork.
problems: No reliable starting point for local legal work

gst-taxation.overview: GST, taxation and filing support for shopkeepers, small businesses and individuals.

business-registration.overview: Support for starting or registering a shop, firm, company or local business.

property-documentation.overview: Help with property papers, registry support, mutation and rent agreement documentation.

police-verification.overview: Guidance for police verification, tenant verification and related affidavits.

electricity.overview: Support for electricity connection, bill, meter and department-related service work.

insurance.overview: Guidance for insurance documents, policy support and claim paperwork.

municipal-services.overview: Help with municipal services, local certificates and city-level civic paperwork.

government-schemes.overview: Help understanding government schemes, eligibility and application steps.

licenses-permits.overview: Support for trade, food, shop and other licenses or permits.

documentation.overview: Professional help for Aadhaar, PAN, certificates, affidavits and other common documents.

labour-compliance.overview: Support for labour registration, contractor paperwork and compliance needs.

labels.benefitsCopy: Clear category selection, verified provider profiles, better document expectations and a more reliable start.

items.question: Are services bookable today?
items.answer: Customer booking is being prepared. Current focus is onboarding and verifying providers.

items.question: Why are there many categories?
items.answer: Bharosa Hai covers everyday work where people need trusted local professionals and correct documents.

items.question: Will providers be verified?
items.answer: Yes. Provider verification is part of the core model before customer visibility.

items.question: Can I suggest a service category?
items.answer: Yes. Use the contact page to suggest a category or city.
